\n    double current_score = solver-\u003emab_reward[current_mode];\n\n    // EMA Update: Score = 0.7 * Score + 0.3 * (P * W)\n    // Initialize score if this is the first selection, otherwise apply EMA\n    if (solver-\u003emab_select[current_mode] == 0) {\n        current_score = P * W;\n    } else {\n        current_score = 0.7 * current_score + 0.3 * (P * W);\n    }\n    solver-\u003emab_reward[current_mode] = current_score;\n\n    // Update usage stats for the just-finished phase\n    solver-\u003emab_select[current_mode]++;\n    \n    // Reset phase counters for the next phase\n    solver-\u003emab_decisions = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_conflicts = 0;\n\n    // Step 4: Determine next mode\n    double score0 = solver-\u003emab_reward[0];\n    double score1 = solver-\u003emab_reward[1];\n    unsigned next_mode = current_mode;\n    bool forced_switch = false;\n\n    // Asymmetric Stagnation Override\n    if (current_mode == 0) { // Focused-like mode\n        // Fail-fast: force switch after only 6 intervals without global progress\n        if (intervals_without_progress \u003e= 6) {\n            next_mode = 1;\n            forced_switch = true;\n            intervals_without_progress = 0;
